mindset: # V19 Gate 0 — LOSS chain, lightweight end-to-end validation (NOT a scientific study)

This is an infrastructure Gate. The ONLY objective is to complete the full production loop — proposal, implementation, validation, real trial training, the forced formal path, inference, scoring, HealthGate evaluation, persistence, and the next iteration — under a deliberately reduced budget (trial 5 min, formal 30 min, tiny data portions).

Scientific competitiveness is explicitly NOT an objective of this Gate. Beating FCNet, beating V18, or maximizing denoising performance are all out of scope. Prioritize successful end-to-end execution and valid numerical output over scientific competitiveness.
propose: Propose a SIMPLE, numerically stable LOSS modification that can be implemented and trained quickly under the reduced Gate budget. This chain remains primarily a loss-focused chain: keep the architecture conservative and compact (a small conventional backbone in roughly the 0.1-2 M parameter range).

Prefer straightforward, well-conditioned loss forms (e.g. weighted/rebalanced cross-entropy variants, simple additive penalty terms with small coefficients, label-smoothing-style modifications) implementable in a few lines of vectorized PyTorch.
Avoid expensive auxiliary networks, multi-stage optimization, large-memory spectral constructions, adversarial components, or losses that require long schedules or warm-up to stabilize.
Everything must work at max_epochs=1 with ~2% training portions and finish a trial attempt well inside a 5-minute wall budget and a formal attempt well inside 30 minutes.
implement: Implement the loss through the existing custom_loss_spec path (or reuse a registered loss when the proposal permits) with the simplest correct realization; pass dummy-tensor forward/backward validation.
Keep the backbone architecture conservative and compact; keep the declared output contract exactly. No per-timestep Python loops.
If the proposal risks the Gate time budget, reduce step count or segment workload — for THIS Gate, small and finished beats large and killed.
tune: Tune minimally: conservative learning rates and loss coefficients, comfortable batch sizes, no aggressive exploration. The Gate has max_rounds=2 (one trial + the forced formal path) — plan for completion, not for score.
Respect the reduced budgets: trial 5 minutes, formal 30 minutes, portions ~2%/1% — never plan workloads sized for the production 20/120-minute budgets.
A HealthGate-invalid round is acceptable Gate output if recorded correctly; do not chase validity with risky changes inside this Gate.
validate: Validate strictly against the plugin and loss contracts; reject unimplementable or contract-violating code as usual. Gate speed is never a reason to weaken validation.
